66a30f00d2999bc7b9bba930 description: Listen close. Medved Cell is not running separate anymore. Sokol, Buran, and Kedr are moving together now, like they still got a war to win. That makes them dangerous, but it also makes them stupid. You catch all three in one raid, you cut the head, the shield, and the eyes off the same beast. Do it before they smell trouble and scatter.
66a30f00d2999bc7b9bba930 note: Sokol calls the shots. Buran takes the hits. Kedr watches the angles. Tony wants all three dropped in the same raid. No loose ends.
66a30f00d2999bc7b9bba930 startedMessageT: This is not a little errand, my friend. This is house cleaning. Sokol, Buran, Kedr. Same raid. One of them walks away, the whole damn cell grows back.
66a30f00d2999bc7b9bba930 successMessageT: Good work. The commander is cold, the shield is cracked, and the scout is quiet. Medved Cell is finished. Now they are just bodies wearing bad patches.
66a30f00d2999bc7b9bba930 failMessageText: No good. One of them is still breathing, and while one breathes, the problem is not dead. Go again when you are ready to finish it proper.
66a30f00d2999bc7b9bba930 acceptPlayerMes: I understand. I will finish Medved Cell.
66a30f02d2999bc7b9bba932: Eliminate Sokol in the same raid.
66a30f05d2999bc7b9bba935: Eliminate Buran in the same raid.
66a30f08d2999bc7b9bba938: Eliminate Kedr in the same raid.
